subject.title: skill safe-encryption-skill: Spec Prohibits File Output But CLI Tool's Standard Interface Is File Output

question: Should ClawHub leave the current version public while requesting publisher correction, or apply a moderation action until it is corrected?
rationale: ClawHub cannot directly patch publisher-owned skill text, and deciding whether ambiguous encryption guidance warrants a hold or exact-version revocation requires human security and content-policy judgment.

options.title: Request publisher correction
options.body: Keep the listing available while asking the publisher to clarify final ciphertext output versus prohibited temporary artifacts.

options.title: Revoke or hold this version
options.body: Temporarily block the current version while allowing a corrected later version to be published.

options.title: Define broader scanner policy
options.body: Create a separate policy effort for detecting contradictory high-risk tool guidance across packages.

recommendation.title: Request publisher correction
recommendation.body: Keep the listing available while asking the publisher to clarify final ciphertext output versus prohibited temporary artifacts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most directly connects this person to moderation policy, reporting, scanning, and exact-version revocation.
